what: The center card stands in front and the side cards overlap inward by progress, shrinking by scale each step (the closer to the front, the higher). With one side card, they overlap heavily and shift 84%, with two, 58%, with three or four, they sit almost side by side. Cards beyond side+1 steps are hidden. Dragging or using arrows advances in .5s

options.scale: Shrink ratio per step, default .2 — Brand facility photo .161, content card (phone) .054, 0 means no shrink
options.side: Number of sheets visible at the side (1~4), default 2
options.scale-md: Scale at 768px and above (or scale if absent)
options.side-md: At 768px or above side (if none, side)
options.gap-md: Gap between sections at 768px and up (px)
options.loop: Repeat, default true — false stops at the end
